# Endpoint Media
> Technical web architecture, Google Ads management, Local SEO, and conversion systems for Johannesburg service businesses.

## Core Entity
- [Homepage](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/): Endpoint Media homepage and primary entity context.
- [Founder](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/about/author/frank-smit): Frank Smit author and founder profile for E-E-A-T validation.
- [Contact](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/contact): Primary sales and audit request endpoint.

## Revenue Services
- [Google Ads Management](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/services/google-ads): Paid search campaign architecture, tracking, and optimization.
- [Website Development](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/services/website-development): Next.js website architecture for speed, search, and conversion.
- [Local SEO](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/services/local-seo): Local search and Google Business Profile growth system.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/services/conversion-rate-optimization): Landing-page and funnel improvements tied to lead quality.
- [Website Design Pricing](https://www.endpointmedia.co.za/services/website-design-prices): Transparent website investment and pricing methodology.
